steps.en: Clone the repo and assemble the root .env.local from the app env files
steps.zh: 克隆仓库，用各 app 的 env 文件拼出根目录 .env.local

steps.en: Starts the infrastructure plus Server and Console, applies DB migrations, serves the console at localhost:4200
steps.zh: 拉起基础设施与 Server/Console，自动迁移，提供控制台

steps.en: Move prompts out of code into the console and deploy versions per environment
steps.zh: 把 prompt 搬进控制台，按环境部署

steps.en: Wire the client SDK into your app
steps.zh: 把客户端 SDK 接进应用

steps.en: Traces every LLM call — prompt version, tokens, cost, latency — and caches repeat requests
steps.zh: 追踪每次调用的版本、成本、延迟，并缓存重复请求

value.en: Roll a prompt forward or back from the UI without a redeploy, with cost and latency visible per call
value.zh: 在 UI 里前进或回滚 prompt 而无需重新部署，每次调用的成本与延迟一目了然
